scope: Applications location gate for Platform, WORLD and Workspace

officialSources.finding: The native move has no initial confirmation dialog. A successful move quits and relaunches the app. conflictHandler can refuse existing and running conflicts.

findings: Location recognition includes all normal Application domains and any path with an Applications component; existing isolated native QA directories satisfy the real API without a stub.
The move destination is NSApplicationDirectory in NSLocalDomainMask, resolved through symlinks, then the current bundle name. This is /Applications, not a preference for ~/Applications.

The administrator-authorized branch bypasses conflictHandler and can remove the destination. The helper therefore inspects the destination and write permissions first and routes protected destinations to Finder without invoking native move.
The ordinary existing/running branches consult conflictHandler. The helper separately confirms replacement and rejects running conflicts.
Successful native movement schedules opening the destination bundle after original process exit. The original startup gate must return without initializing accounts or windows.

behavior.proposal: once per process while outside Applications
behavior.existingDestination: explicit confirmation before native call; native conflictHandler retained for later conflicts
behavior.protectedDestination: manual Finder move guidance, current copy continues
behavior.runningConflict: refuse move and explain that the existing app must fully quit
behavior.declinedOrFailed: warn that updates may affect another copy, then continue the current copy
behavior.successful: Electron handles quit/relaunch; original process does not initialize main
